key_insight: A unified Hessian-guided objective jointly optimizes quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding to account for their effects on model outputs.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets more accurate low-bit LLM deployment while reducing memory footprint and computational cost.
method: Approximate output changes from joint weight and activation quantization using Hessian information.
Use a tractable Fisher approximation to capture output sensitivity.
Jointly optimize ranges, transformations, and rounding under a shared objective.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods in channel-wise and block-wise settings, but provides no numerical results or benchmark details.
watch_item: The accuracy–cost trade-off of the Fisher approximation needs verification for the intended model and deployment setting.
paper_title: A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
